notes:
PASS on the fake backend: G1-G6 and G9 pass, G7 warns G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x2, G8 warns G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE, and the gate exits 0. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card proposes the MujocoDriver family helper and has an empty models list, but the card's entry class is a BDDL/robosuite environment, not a raw MJCF model: Libero_Coffee_Table_Manipulation parses a BDDL task file and builds a robosuite/MuJoCo scene in its constructor (libero/libero/envs/bddl_base_domain.py:42-160, :297). A MujocoDriver serves one MJCF file through model_path/mj_step and cannot carry a BDDL task, the environment step(action) interface or the card's missing model. The package is therefore a direct Driver over the first card entry symbol, libero.libero.envs.problems.libero_coffee_table_manipulation:Libero_Coffee_Table_Manipulation, with the package fake .fake:FakeLiberoCoffeeTableManipulation; it still binds the card's cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.step.v1. Only this one of the five entry classes is served. The fake is a physics-free F0 stand-in: MuJoCo, robosuite and bddl are not installed (checked with importlib.util.find_spec), the upstream package was never installed or run, and the clone was never imported; numpy is present but the fake uses plain Python. The fake's arrays are placeholders, and it reports done false and reward 0.0. NOT COVERED: the agentview and robot0_eye_in_hand camera images and the object observation arrays: the real observation also carries them when the constructor defaults are used (bddl_base_domain.py:51 and :67-69), and their keys and lengths depend on the BDDL task and the camera configuration. The action vector shape is a constructor option (the wrapper default controller is OSC_POSE, env_wrapper.py:17), and control_freq is a constructor option with default 20 (bddl_base_domain.py:63), so timestep_ms is 0 and the driver invents no action or timestep bound. Warnings kept: G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for reset and close, which come from robosuite's SingleArmEnv, a base outside the clone (the clone only shows the class BDDLBaseDomain(SingleArmEnv) at bddl_base_domain.py:37) and both names occur throughout the clone; G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because the package declares no sourced Limit on an actuating capability: the ticks 1..10000 and seed >= 0 bounds are catalogue class schema, refused as MHS.CAPABILITY.INPUT_INVALID rather than an envelope limit, so an operator_required or invented Limit was not appropriate. No site-limits.example.json is needed. This package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by stays null); it was checked on the fake backend only and no hardware run was made. The digest above is from the last gate run.
